rosters.notes: 384 students. Both group columns state their value once for a run of students and merge the rest of the run, so the merged ranges are what defines a cohort, not the rows. The subgroup column writes 'a1' where the schema says 'A1'; the mapping is declared value by value rather than case-folded, because Turkish upper-casing turns 'i' into 'İ' and would invent a cohort out of an English list (ADR-130). The list states no anatomyGroup, which Grade 2 Turkish also requires, so a student always enters that one. Three numbers begin '97' rather than the faculty code '01' and are refused by StudentProfileValidator, so those students cannot save a profile today. Two numbers are stored numerically and have lost a leading zero. Student number 0101240080 is also on the Grade 3 Turkish list, which makes it ambiguous.

113 students. The Grade 2 English program is deliberately absent from the supported profile schema (ADR-084), so this list suggests nothing until that program opens; it is catalogued because the document exists and its shape is now known. The two dimensions are genuinely independent and the document proves it: the İ1/İ2 boundary falls on row 56 while the i1/i2/i3 boundaries fall on rows 34 and 78, so i2 spans both general groups. They must not be collapsed on the grounds that their labels differ mostly by typography (ADR-085). One number is stored numerically and has lost a leading zero. The faculty publishes given names and surnames already masked here.

The Turkish half of the combined 2026-2027 Dönem-3 student list ('D3 Öğrenci Listesi'), which for 2026-2027 replaced the separate Turkish-only list this roster used to point at (ADR-160). The one document holds both programs' Grade 3 students — the Turkish (0101…) and the English (0102…) — so it is catalogued once per program like the microbiology/pathology list and this Turkish entry claims only the 0101 rows via studentNumberProgramPrefix (the English rows are the sibling G3-EN-FACULTY-ROSTER's, ADR-145/ADR-160). Column D ('Grubu') is the curriculum group and column E the faculty-practice cohort. The curriculum group is a Turkish-only division — the English program has none (ADR-098) — so only this Turkish entry reads column D; the faculty-practice cohort spans both programs and both entries read column E. The list is one A run and one B run: column D states 'A grubu' (rows 2-221) and 'B grubu' (rows 222-441), each a merged run. The faculty-practice cohort is in column E as a per-student value written lowercase 'a1'…'a8' for the A group and 'b1'…'b8' for the B group, each cohort its own merged run; it is mapped value by value onto the schema's 'A1'…'B8' rather than case-folded, for the reason G2-TR gives (Turkish upper-casing would invent a different cohort out of a lowercase 'i', ADR-085/ADR-130). Column E has no header of its own, so it is addressed by letter like the microbiology/pathology group column. facultyPracticeGroup depends on curriculumGroup in the schema (A-group students may only be A1-A8), which the two merged runs keep consistent. microPathologyGroup is the remaining Grade 3 Turkish dimension and is stated by G3-TR-MICROPATHO-ROSTER, which merges with this list. Two numbers begin '9701' rather than the faculty code and are refused by StudentProfileValidator, and 0101240080 is also on the Grade 2 Turkish list. The used range runs to column Z although only A-E hold anything.

96 students. This list itself states no group — it confirms identity only — and its header is written 'OgrenciNo' without Turkish letters or a space, unlike the other three. No malformed numbers. The program has no A/B curriculum group (ADR-098 stands on that point); its one group, the faculty-practice cohort a1-a4, is now stated by the sibling G3-EN-FACULTY-ROSTER below (the English rows of the combined list), and its microbiology/pathology group by G3-EN-MICROPATHO-ROSTER, both of which merge with this one (ADR-160).

rosters.displayName: Dönem 3 İngilizce öğretim üyesi uygulama grup listesi
rosters.notes: The English half of the combined 2026-2027 Dönem-3 student list — the same document G3-TR-ROSTER reads, claiming only the 0102 rows via studentNumberProgramPrefix (ADR-145's shared-document pattern, extended to the faculty-practice group by ADR-160). Grade 3 English has no A/B curriculum group of its own: the whole program attends its theoretical lessons together (the English annual states no cohort, ADR-098), so this list deliberately does NOT read column D ('Grubu'), even though the shared sheet is laid out by the Turkish curriculum group. The one English division is the faculty-practice group, stated in column E as lowercase 'a1'…'a4' — the English students fall in those four cohorts only — mapped value by value onto the schema's 'A1'…'A4' (never case-folded, ADR-130), addressed by letter because the column has no header. It merges with G3-EN-ROSTER (identity) and G3-EN-MICROPATHO-ROSTER (microbiology/pathology group): the three are complementary lists of one cohort stating disjoint dimensions, so the lookup unions them rather than treating the shared number as ambiguous (ADR-145). The lessons these cohorts receive are published by G3-EN-A-FACULTY, which converts the A-group faculty document for English and — because English has no curriculum group — drops the curriculumGroup selector its Turkish sibling keeps, so an English facultyPracticeGroup-only profile matches (ADR-160).

426 students in one file covering both programs — the Turkish (0101…) and English (0102…) Grade 3 students — split into four microbiology/pathology practice groups A1/A2/B1/B2 in four merged runs of column D (rows 2-107, 108-213, 214-319, 320-427). The group column has no header, so it is addressed by letter. This Turkish entry claims only the 0101 rows via studentNumberProgramPrefix; the English entry below claims the 0102 rows from the same file (ADR-145). It complements G3-TR-ROSTER, which states the curriculum group, so a Grade 3 Turkish student is on both lists and the lookup merges them. One number begins '97' rather than the faculty code and is not this program's, so it is skipped by both program entries. Two numbers are stored numerically and have lost a leading zero, restored on read.

The English half of the shared microbiology/pathology group list (ADR-145): the same file as the Turkish entry above, claiming only the 0102 rows. It is what makes Grade 3 English onboardable — the only list of the program that states a cohort — and it merges with G3-EN-ROSTER, which confirms identity but states no group. 96 English students across the same four A1/A2/B1/B2 groups.
